requirements.description: Student residence: universities and schools must be nearby. Threshold set at the 75th percentile (75.14), rounded to 75.
Residents will need convenient metro, bus, and station access to reach campus and the city. Threshold set at the 75th percentile (70.93), rounded to 71.
The user requires energy class C or better, so every class from C up to A1 is included.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 850. The capacity of 60 people is not converted into an area requirement because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. The energy class C requirement, the Turin location, and the CDP/PNRR funding purpose are not REFERENCE COLUMNS and are not used as filters.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850, energy_class in A1–A4/B/C, education >= 75 and mobility >= 71, restricted to a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by distance from that point. The capacity of 60 people has no matching column, so it is not filtered on.
